name: openworker-arcade
description: A desktop game studio built on the OpenWorker Harness SDK

scripts.build: npm run sdk && npm run build:main && tsc -p tsconfig.json && vite build
scripts.test: npm run build:main && node --test test/storage.test.mjs test/projection.test.mjs test/projects.test.mjs test/starters.test.mjs test/assets.test.mjs test/game-progress.test.mjs test/asset-catalog.test.mjs test/review.test.mjs test/test-evidence.test.mjs
scripts.test:integration: npm run sdk && npm run build:main && node --test test/integration.test.mjs test/provider-probe.test.mjs test/project-agent.test.mjs test/preview-agent.test.mjs
scripts.test:playtest: npm run build && node test/playtest-ui.mjs && node test/playtest-app-ui.mjs
scripts.test:ui: npm run build && node test/offline-ui.mjs && node test/ui.mjs && node test/studio-ui.mjs && node test/discovery-ui.mjs && node test/review-ui.mjs
scripts.test:starters: node starter-games/neon-drift/test.mjs && node starter-games/lumen-garden/test.mjs && node --test starter-games/skybound-carrier/test.mjs starter-games/moonlight-rally/test.mjs starter-games/pip-garden/test.mjs
scripts.package: npm run runtime && npm run build && electron-builder --dir
scripts.dist:app: npm run runtime && npm run build && electron-builder
